preconditions.description: The length of the input string t must be between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string t must be lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the original string s prefixed with '!' and followed by a newline.
The length of the restored string s must be equal to the length of the input string t.
